1. Introduction¶

This page documents the Sample Instruction Set Architecture.

9. Instruction Set

9.1. Widget Instructions

9.1.1. Widget Instructions: frob¶

frob

Copy a widget from one register file to another.

Syntax

frob{.fast}.vec.type d, [a];
frob.relaxed.scope.type d, [a];

.vec =    { .v2, .v4 };
.type =   { .u8, .f32 };
.scope =  { .cta, .cluster };

Description

Read the widget operand and write the destination register.

PTX ISA Notes

frob introduced in PTX ISA version 2.0.

frob.relaxed introduced in PTX ISA version 3.1.

Target ISA Notes

frob requires sm_75 or higher.

frob.relaxed requires sm_80 or higher.

Examples

frob.v4.f32 d, [a];

9.1.2. Widget Instructions: frob.nc¶

frob.nc

Copy a widget without caching the source line.

Syntax

frob.nc{.fast}.type d, [a];

.type = { .u8 };
.scope = { .cta, .relaxed };

PTX ISA Notes

frob.nc introduced in PTX ISA version 8.0.

Target ISA Notes

frob.nc requires sm_90 or higher.

9.1.3. Widget Instructions: zzz

zzz

Reserved for a future revision. No syntax is defined.

9.1.4. Widget Instructions: floss

floss

Floss one widget against another.

Syntax

floss.sync.mode.type d, [a], membermask;

.mode =  { .cta, .cluster };
.type =  { .u32 };

Description

Supports e.g. Rounding and saturation modes. The second sentence is not the summary.

A second paragraph stays a separate line.

Semantics

Writes d with the flossed widget value.

Notes

Only the first sentence of Description sets the summary.

PTX ISA Notes

floss introduced in PTX ISA version 7.0.

Target ISA Notes

floss requires sm_80 or higher.

Examples

floss.sync.cta.u32 %d, [%a], %m;
floss.sync.cluster.u32 %d, [%a], %m;

9.2. Matrix Instructions

9.2.1. Matrix Instructions: twiddle

twiddle

Twiddle one matrix fragment against another.

Syntax

twiddle.sync.aligned.shape.row.col.dtype b, c, d;
twiddle.sync.aligned.shape.row.col.kind b, c, d, e;

.shape = { .m8n8, .m16n8 };
.dtype = { .f16, .f32 };
.kind =   { .a, .b };

PTX ISA Notes

twiddle introduced in PTX ISA version 8.0.

Target ISA Notes

twiddle requires sm_90 or higher.

9.3. Cache Instructions

9.3.1. Cache Instructions: flop, floop

flop, floop

Pull a cache line ahead of use.

Syntax

flop{.level} [a];
floop.L1 [a];

.level = { .L1, .L2 };
